question: ‘Bolak-aat’ is a ______ from the state of Karnataka.
solution:
The correct answer is __**dance form**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bolak-aat is a folk dance form of Karnataka.**

 
 
• It is believed that Lord Vishnu, on his mission to kill the evil spirit 'Bhasmasura', performed 30 different dance forms, and ‘Bolkat’ is one among them.
 
• The dancers dress up in traditional Kodava dress and are Performed by Kodava men in the back of an oil lamp in an open field. 
 
• The performers hold 'chavari', Yak-animal's fur on one hand and 'Kodava', (Sickle) on another hand.
 
• If only the sickle is used in the dance, then it is called 'kattiyaata'.
 
• The musical instrument used for this dance is called ‘Dudi’.
 
• The theme of the dance is based on the heroic activities of the Kodava gods and goddesses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
